canonicalization.file_selection: pyproject.toml and every regular distribution source file below src/lims_eln_contracts
canonicalization.symlink_behavior: reject the scope root or any selected entry

authentication_posture: Git supplies credentials through a configured credential helper or short-lived GitHub App token; the requirement text carries no credential.

required_observations: vcs_info.commit_id equals the reviewed full commit
the scoped package source digest matches the reviewed binding
the implementation and simulation shaped observations load
every released schema in SCHEMA_RESOURCE_NAMES loads as a JSON object

replacement_rule: A later full commit may replace this coordinate at the same package version when its scoped package digest is identical; a package-content change advances the version and digest, and consumers adopt either replacement through review.
